forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
In week 44 of October, 4 survey teams and 4 clearance teams were active. Teams completed 2 visits; there were no zone surveys, technical surveys or clearances. So far, 29 zones have been surveyed, 10 declared free, 29 areas released and 13 cleared. Mines were found in 9 areas; 579 suspected or confirmed areas remain open.

For attention: 9 zones are closed according to the access feed. 0 teams were stood down, 0 had no report for more than a week, 0 reports were held or queried, and 0 dossiers were held. No new plan was approved; the current plan is P10. Teams worked 18 team-days, with 22 lost to rain or wind.

The forecast for the zones of the plan it was made with, counting what is done already, is 12 to 14 mine areas cleared this season and 10 to 11 zones declared free this season, P10 to P90.
